card.name: Royal Ballet of Cambodia (Apsara)
card.era: Linked to the Khmer court for over 1,000 years
card.tagline: Cambodia's sacred classical court dance of royal wealth
card.profile: The Royal Ballet of Cambodia (Robam Preah Reach Trop, "dance of royal wealth"), also called Khmer classical dance, is renowned for graceful hand gestures and elaborate costumes and has been associated with the Khmer court for over a thousand years (Wikipedia; UNESCO). Performed at coronations, weddings, funerals and Khmer holidays to a pinpeat ensemble with a sung narration, its repertory perpetuates legends of the Reamker; four character types exist — neang (woman), neayrong (man), yeak (giant) and sva (monkey).
card.insight: Infused with a sacred, symbolic role embodying refinement, respect and spirituality, the Royal Ballet practically ceased to exist under the Khmer Rouge, who killed almost all master dancers; it was proclaimed a Masterpiece of the Oral and Intangible Heritage of Humanity by UNESCO on November 7, 2003 (inscribed on the Representative List in 2008) and is cherished as the emblem of Khmer culture.
card.image_significance: Dance of the gods. A representative image shows ceremonial regalia in a ritual context — imagery should be handled respectfully, not as spectacle — Khmer court, Cambodia.
